assumptions: The tube holds K bead populations, K the rows of the MEF table, the blank first.
limits: flowBeads' scatter gate (norm2Filter) is a separate step and is not applied, as gateBeads does not.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which bead population is each event, and how does each channel map to MEF?

description: flowBeads gateBeads on a calibration-bead FCS tube in the project and its lot's MEF table: every bead population (flowCore's default logicle, quantile-seeded R k-means per channel, the median label per event), each population's count, mean, SD and CV per channel, and for every certified channel the least-squares line trans(MEF) = alpha + beta * trans(MFI) with its residual standard error.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

mef.description: the lot's MEF table in the project (';'-separated, the blank row first), by name or id.

tube.description: the bead FCS file in the project, by name or id.

mef.description: per certified channel: alpha, beta and the residual standard error

stats.description: per channel, per bead population: count, mean, SD, CV
